title: Senior Fabric Data Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Provitious Technologies helps businesses automate, scale, and innovate through smart, measurable technology solutions. The company designs adaptive systems that enhance performance, offering services such as Custom Software Development, Business Process Automation, and Microsoft Power Platform solutions. With core expertise in Power BI, Power Automate, PowerApps, Cloud Computing, DevOps, and IT Consulting, Provitious Technologies serves diverse industries including Real Estate, Healthcare, Supply Chain, Finance, Government, and more. Guided by precision and collaboration, the team focuses on simplifying technology, empowering teams, and enabling data-driven decisions. Based in India, Provitious Technologies partners with clients worldwide to build efficient, scalable, and seamless digital solutions.
  
  
  
**Job Description:**
We are looking for an experienced
**Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer**
to design and implement a global HR data platform using
**Microsoft Fabric, OneLake and Data Factory**
.
  
  
The candidate will work on integrating multiple regional HRIS platforms and heterogeneous data sources into a governed enterprise HR analytics platform, supporting secure data processing, transformation, quality validation and Power BI reporting.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement ingestion pipelines using Microsoft Fabric Data Factory.
* Integrate HRIS systems through REST APIs, SFTP, CSV, Excel and secure file-based interfaces.
* Build Bronze, Silver and Gold data layers in OneLake/Fabric.
* Develop source-specific mapping and transformation logic.
* Handle multilingual data, different layouts, date formats, number formats and code translations.
* Implement incremental and full-load strategies.
* Develop duplicate prevention and reconciliation processes.
* Implement error handling, retry and exception/replay mechanisms.
* Build data quality and freshness validation.
* Develop canonical/global HR data models.
* Implement secure handling of confidential HR data.
* Work with the security architect to implement least-privilege access.
* Support Power BI semantic models and reporting.
* Implement monitoring, audit and data lineage.
* Support onboarding of additional HRIS systems.

**Required Skiis:**
Microsoft Fabric: Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Fabric Data Factory, Lakehouse, Fabric Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2
  
  
Data Engineering: SQL, ETL/ELT, Data Transformation, Data Modeling, Bronze/Silver/Gold Architecture, Delta Lake, Parquet
  
  
Data Integration: REST APIs, JSON, SFTP, CSV, Excel, API Authentication, Secure File Transfer, Incremental and Full Data Loads
  
  
Data Quality & Processing: Data Validation, Data Reconciliation, Duplicate Detection, Error Handling, Retry Mechanisms, Data Mapping, Data Lineage
  
  
Security & Governance: Microsoft Entra ID, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Fabric Permissions, OneLake Security, Managed Identities, Azure Key Vault, Least-Privilege Access
  
  
Azure & Cloud: Microsoft Azure, Azure Storage, Azure Integration Services, Cloud Data Platforms
  
  
Preferred Skills:Power BI, DAX, HRIS Integration, HR Data Models, Data Governance, Microsoft Purview, Enterprise Data Warehousing
  
  
5+ years data engineering experience with at least: 2+ years Microsoft Fabric / modern Azure data platform experience and demonstrated experience with:
  

* Multiple source integrations
* Enterprise data platforms
* Confidential/sensitive data
* Data warehouse/lakehouse implementations
* Production-grade data pipelines

title: Data Engineer I
description:
Job Title: Data Engineer I

Department & Campaign: Etech insight

Reports to :Data Engineer II/Data Engineering Leader I/II

Location:Onshore/Near Shore/Farshore

**JOB SUMMARY:**
Data Engineer I is responsible for monitoring the activities of a group of Lead Analysts and/or Lead Analysts II. Data Engineer I takes accountability of the audit process of all the campaigns assigned to him/her. Responsible to create a bench of leaders develop them to take up higher responsibilities. Data Engineer I takes the initiative to align campaign metrics with Etech Insights deliverables.

**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES AND ESSENTIAL DUTIES:**
include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

·        
**Process Development & Optimization**
: Take accountability of campaign audit from launch to smooth running of audits, sending out periodical reports, daily feedback etc.

·        
**Communication across Department**
: Will interact with PI to launch the audit process for new campaigns assigned by Insights Leader/Sr. Insights Leader. Will interact with Operations to ensure that the expectations in terms of QA support to the campaigns are met.

·        
**Quality Assurance Oversight**
: Design Audit Forms, get it approved by Ops and Client and place it online in QEval. Initiate MI/BI studies as and when required. Take initiatives for process improvement.

·        
**Data Analysis & Reporting**
: Conduct regular analysis of QA metrics, trends, and performance data, prepare reports for senior leadership and provide actionable insights to improve service quality.

·        
**Coaching & Feedback**
: Provide constructive feedback and coaching to agents based on QA evaluations, helping them improve their performance and customer interactions.

·        
**Training**
: Train and develop new Analysts and/or Lead Analysts, ensuring they are equipped with the knowledge and tools to evaluate and support agents effectively.

·        
**Cross-Department Collaboration**
: Work closely with team leaders, supervisors, and other departments to ensure QA findings are addressed and best practices are integrated into daily operations.

·        
**Develop QA Standards**
: Establish and maintain clear quality standards, ensuring they align with the company’s customer service goals and objectives.

·        
**Process related activities**
: Understand the SLA of the campaigns in terms of QA support and ensure that those are met. Initiate MI/BI studies as and when necessary.

·        
**Meetings & Calibrations:**
This includes internal and external client meetings and calibration sessions – where the Lead Analysts II will help in setting up calibrations and provide all assistance to Analysts and Lead Analysts in maintaining a smooth calibration process

·        
**Root Cause Analysis**
: Identify recurring issues or patterns in customer interactions, conducting root cause analysis to recommend improvements or training needs.

·        
**Customer Satisfaction Focus**
: Ensure that the quality assurance process is aligned with the goal of delivering superior customer experience, helping the team meet KPIs such as Customer Satisfaction (CSAT), Net Promoter Score (NPS), and First Call Resolution (FCR).

·        
**Reporting & Documentation**
: Maintain accurate records of QA findings and agent performance. Provide periodic reports and insights on team performance, trends, and opportunities for improvement.

·        
**Core Leadership tasks:**
As a leader within EI, responsible for overseeing a team of direct reports. Further, carrying out supervisory duties in alignment with the organization's policies and applicable laws, such as interviewing, hiring, and monitoring employees. Additionally, coach and develop team members, plan, assign, and direct work, appraise performance, and address employee concerns, while also rewarding and disciplining as needed to resolve issues and ensure smooth operations.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS/SKILL SET:**

·        Minimum of 3 years’ experience in quality management or contact center operations

·        A minimum of a High School Diploma/high school grade 12 education (offshore locations), GED or equivalent is required.

·        Proven experience leading a team, coaching, and providing performance feedback.

·        Strong understanding of customer service principles and quality assurance standards.

·        Familiarity with contact center technologies (CRM systems, call monitoring tools, reporting software).

·        Excellent interpersonal, problem-solving and decision-making skills.

·        Attention to detail and ability to identify trends and gaps in service quality.

·        Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

·        Maintain a minimum 95% schedule adherence of self and the team.

·        Must be accessible, available and flexible with shift timings.

·        Personal: Excellent Written, Verbal English Communication skills and Excel (Data Analysis) are a prerequisite.

·        Proven experience with
**Microsoft Office Suite**
(Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, etc.).

o  Strong proficiency in
**Excel**
, including functions, formulas, data analysis, and reporting.

o  Experience with
**Word formatting**
and document preparation.

o  Ability to create and manage
**PowerPoint presentations**
and slideshows.

·        Excellent
**time management**
and
**organizational skills**
.

·        Basic SQL (Structured Query Language) & Python knowledge is essential for working with databases, extracting data, performing data analysis, data manipulation and automation

·        Sufficient knowledge on
**Data Visualization**
and
**Storytelling**
to present complex data in accessible, persuasive and impactful ways and engage the clients/audience

·        Accustomed to
**Common Statistical Functions**
that allow them to effectively analyze and interpret data, derive insights and make informed decisions.

·        
**Advanced Analytics**
- Data mining techniques: this includes familiarity with uncovering hidden patterns in data, such as regression analysis, clustering or decision trees.

·        
**Proficiency in BI tools**
requires analyzing and present data effectively.

title: Sr. Data Architect – Startups
description:
**Role Overview**
 We’re looking for a Senior Data Architect to own our data warehousing and database infrastructure across all our startups. You’ll design and build the systems that turn raw data into a reliable, scalable foundation for reporting and analytics, while owning day\-to\-day database administration, performance, and security. This is a high\-ownership role with the mandate to build the data backbone that supports every business unit.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and build a scalable data warehouse architecture supporting multiple startups
* Design data models optimized for analytics and reporting
* Build, orchestrate, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines
* Administer, tune, and maintain PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server and MongoDB across environments
* Write and optimize advanced SQL queries; design and manage indexing strategies for performance
* Build data integrations and automation
* Define and enforce data governance, access control, and security standards
* Own backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning for all databases
* Monitor database health, proactively identify bottlenecks, and resolve performance issues
* Partner with engineering, product, and analytics teams to translate data needs into architecture
* Document data architecture, schemas, pipelines, and operational runbooks
* Monitor and optimize Azure cloud costs, ensuring infrastructure spend stays efficient as data volume and usage scale


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent practical experience is welcome.

title: Industrial Engineer (P2)
description:
**About Analog Devices**
 Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
 Analog Devices is seeking an experienced Industrial Engineer to join the Central Industrial Engineering team. This role will lead high\-impact initiatives focused on capacity modeling, factory scheduling, cycle time reduction, operations research, and productivity improvement across ADI's front\-end manufacturing network. The successful candidate will drive development of cross\-site analytical models, optimization tools, and data\-driven decision systems that maximize factory output, support expansion planning, and establish standardized Industrial Engineering practices across multiple manufacturing sites.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead development of cross\-site capacity models, utilization analyses, loading scenarios, and expansion planning studies.
* Drive cycle time reduction and WIP optimization initiatives through Factory Physics methodologies, bottleneck analysis, and constraint management.
* Develop and maintain advanced analytical tools supporting factory scheduling, output optimization, and operational decision making.
* Perform operations research and statistical analyses to identify key output levers and productivity improvement opportunities.
* Design and implement predictive models, optimization algorithms, and AI\-enabled analytical solutions for manufacturing applications.
* Lead validation and continuous improvement of scheduling logic, factory planning assumptions, and manufacturing data structures.
* Establish standard methodologies, governance processes, and best practices across multiple manufacturing sites.
* Mentor junior Industrial Engineers and provide technical leadership on analytical projects.
* Partner with site leadership, operations teams, supply chain, manufacturing engineering, and IT to drive strategic improvement initiatives.
* Present recommendations, scenario analyses, and business cases to management and senior leadership.
* Support development of long\-range capacity plans and fab expansion scenarios.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Manufacturing Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related engineering discipline.
* Proficiency in SQL, Python, Power BI, and statistical analysis tools.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Data Science, Analytics, or related field.
* Semiconductor wafer fabrication experience.
* Experience with Factory Physics, cycle time engineering, capacity planning, production scheduling, or manufacturing optimization.
* Experience with simulation, optimization modeling, machine learning, or operations research techniques.


**Work Experience**
* 3–5 years of Industrial Engineering experience in semiconductor manufacturing or other complex manufacturing environments.
* Experience building capacity models, productivity analyses, factory scheduling models, or optimization tools.
* Demonstrated success leading cross\-functional improvement initiatives.
* Strong analytical, communication, and project leadership skills.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams is preferred.


*For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce \- Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State \- Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*
